items.title: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
items.en_title: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
items.en_oneliner: The two sides are deepening their partnership: OpenAI models and agents are coming to ServiceNow, while ServiceNow workflows are heading into ChatGPT and Codex.

items.title: Fine-Tuning vs. Frozen Embeddings: When to Adapt the LLM vs. the Sklearn Head
items.en_title: Fine-Tuning vs. Frozen Embeddings: When to Adapt the LLM vs. the Sklearn Head
items.en_oneliner: The article weighs two ways to adapt a model to a domain — LoRA fine-tuning versus frozen embeddings with only the sklearn head trained — and shows how to choose by scenario.

items.en_oneliner: Legora leans on OpenAI models, ChatGPT, and Codex to speed up legal workflows and widen contract analysis, freeing lawyers for higher-value work.

items.title: The sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning
items.en_title: The sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning
items.en_oneliner: Google's research introduces the sleep framework, a new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning by consolidating what they have learned.
